2609.04489.title: Towards Understanding Pause Token Fine-Tuning Dynamics: A Mode Retention Perspective
2609.04489.paper_summary: Pause-token methods improve LLM reasoning by inserting special tokens into sequences. Prior work explains these gains through computational expressivity. However, there is relatively little investigation into the training dynamics of pause tokens. We explore how pause tokens reshape the training dynamics of fine-tuning. Two controlled pilots expose distinct asymmetries. On a synthetic continual-learning task, masked pauses overwrite a previously-learned distribution roughly 4x less at matched final adaptation (H1, mode retention); on a synthetic math-reasoning probe, the boundary-adjacent token comes to encode substantially more downstream-step information (H2, non-myopic compression). We formalize a training rule consistent with both - Masked Boundary Pause (MBP), pause tokens placed at reasoning-step boundaries with their loss masked. Across 1B-8B Qwen and Llama models, MBP consistently improves reasoning, achieving gains of up to 6 points on math and 2.5 points on code, while preserving general language understanding abilities. We further demonstrate that this mode-preserving strategy extend gains to GRPO. These results recast pause tokens as a training-dynamics intervention on the retention-adaptation trade-off, rather than merely an inference-time computation device.
2609.04489.paper_summary_zh: 暫停標記方法透過將特殊標記插入序列來改善大型語言模型的推理。先前的研究通過計算表達能力解釋了這些增益。然而，對於暫停標記的訓練動態的研究相對較少。我們探討暫停標記如何重塑微調的訓練動態。兩個受控試點揭示了明顯的不對稱性。在一個合成的持續學習任務中，遮蔽的暫停在匹配的最終適應下，覆蓋先前學習的分佈的程度約為 4 倍較少（假設 1，模式保留）；在一個合成的數學推理探測中，邊界相鄰的標記編碼了實質上更多的下游步驟信息（假設 2，非短視壓縮）。我們正式化了一個與兩者一致的訓練規則 - 遮蔽邊界暫停（MBP），在推理步驟邊界放置的暫停標記，其損失被遮蔽。在 1B-8B 的 Qwen 和 Llama 模型中，MBP 一貫改善推理，數學上獲得最高 6 分，代碼上獲得 2.5 分的增益，同時保持一般語言理解能力。我們進一步證明這種保留模式的策略將增益擴展到 GRPO。這些結果將暫停標記重新定義為對保留-適應權衡的訓練動態干預，而不僅僅是推理時的計算設備。
